config.scope: Post-confirmation diagnostics on frozen sources. Enumerate all six orientations of every per-source orbit unexposed to that source's training/validation and all previously examined tests; orbit is the sampling unit. Natural-state interchange preserves the recipient's complete first-step logits. Distinct-future and same-future donors are selected by exact gold answers before predictions, with orbit exclusions and no oracle-accuracy filtering. Same-gold-answer natural components can still yield off-manifold hybrids. Secondary TOST on old sources is descriptive and does not establish pre-registered equivalence. Ridge changes the objective and is a numerical sensitivity analysis, not the original same-loss certificate. No equivalence or natural relation-specific causal mechanism is presumed.
